baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled يُولِجُ reverses night and day as object and container.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mirrored clauses depict reciprocal interpenetration: each temporal domain is progressively admitted into the other rather than merely replacing it at a hard boundary.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies the literal transfer of one domain into the interior of another.
Night supplies the dark temporal pole repeated on both sides of the reversal.
Day supplies the opened, illuminated temporal pole that alternately contains and is contained.

changed_reading.before: Night simply follows day, and day follows night.
changed_reading.after: Night and day have porous limits; portions of each are continually inserted into the other.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Cosmic ingress is immediately followed by knowledge of what breasts contain.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah repeats an inside-reaching grammar across scales: temporal domains receive one another, while divine knowledge reaches the inward source from which human acts issue.

activation_trace.role: The image of an entry-place makes interior access, not only succession, salient.
Knowledge supplies the disclosure that crosses the inward boundary.
The breast as an originating source makes hidden content potentially productive of outward action.

changed_reading.before: The omniscience clause is appended to an astronomical sign.
changed_reading.after: Astronomical ingress and knowledge of breasts form one inside/outside claim: no containing boundary makes its contents opaque.

context_deltas.mechanism: Manifest/hidden language and the wall whose inside and outside carry opposed outcomes turn the focus ayah's ingress into movement across consequential states of disclosure and concealment.

activation_trace.role: Mutual ingress supplies the crossing between contained and exposed states.
The breast supplies a hidden source whose effects can emerge.
Manifestness contributes emergence and exposure as one pole of the topology.
Hidden inwardness contributes the concealed pole paired with manifestation.
The wall's inside makes inward location concrete and outcome-bearing.
The wall's outside supplies the opposed face of the same boundary.

structural_cues: 57:3 pairs the Manifest and Hidden; 57:13 assigns mercy inside a wall and punishment outside it.
57:6 reverses object and container before naming knowledge of breasts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed inner/outer states and a boundary; I infer that reciprocal ingress can cross states, not only hours. A live alternative is ordinary seasonal lengthening.

changed_reading.before: Night and day are two time spans that overlap.
changed_reading.after: Their overlap models a governed crossing between hidden and manifest conditions, while the breast clause asserts knowledge on the concealed side.

context_deltas.mechanism: The neighboring inventory of what enters and exits earth and descends and ascends through heaven expands the two night/day clauses into one multidirectional circulation under knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies reciprocal entry between temporal containers.
Entry into earth repeats the focus verb and places it in a larger traffic pattern.
Exit supplies the outward counterdirection implicit but unstated in the focus.
Descent adds a downward axis to the circulation.
Ascent closes the vertical counterflow and makes the system bidirectional.

structural_cues: 57:4 orders enter/exit and descend/ascend as paired reversals under يَعْلَمُ.
57:6 likewise repeats ingress in reversed order and ends with عَلِيمٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the four directions; I infer that the reversed night/day clauses instantiate the same circulation. They may instead be separate signs merely sharing divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The ayah describes a self-contained daily alternation.
changed_reading.after: Night/day interpenetration is one horizontal-temporal circuit within a larger enter/exit and descend/ascend traffic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit extraction from darknesses into light activates an asymmetric reading inside the focus's otherwise reciprocal night/day exchange: ingress can be the medium of a directed release into disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Night contributes darkness as the departure pole.
Day contributes opened illumination as the arrival pole.
Extraction supplies directed passage from an interior condition to an exterior one.
Light supplies the disclosed destination of that passage.

structural_cues: 57:9 explicitly moves people from plural darknesses to singular light.
57:6 names night first, then day, while preserving the reverse movement as a coexisting cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet gives an explicit moral extraction; I map its poles onto focus night/day. The live alternative is that 57:9's transition is distinct from astronomical interchange.

changed_reading.before: Both directions of night/day ingress are morally neutral and equivalent.
changed_reading.after: Without canceling reciprocity, the sequence can also stage a directed emergence from obscurity into light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence self-testing, waiting, doubting, and deception by bright but unstable wishes makes what breasts contain a developing causal process rather than a static secret.

activation_trace.role: Repeated entering and leaving contributes temporal recurrence in which an inward process can develop.
The breast as source anchors the contextual sequence as productive inward causation.
Testing supplies the initiating pressure applied to the self.
The inward mind and apprehension locate the process within the person.
Waiting contributes duration rather than an instantaneous hidden state.
Disturbed doubt supplies an intermediate inward deformation.
Deceptive brightness supplies the culminating false appearance that masks the process.

structural_cues: 57:14 presents the inward failures as a verb chain ending in an outwardly decisive separation.
57:6 places recurring temporal ingress immediately before knowledge of breasts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the staged inner chain; I infer that repeated temporal passage lets hidden dispositions mature and become legible. Alternatively, the cosmic cycle only demonstrates omniscience without causing or timing the chain.

changed_reading.before: God knows a fixed inventory of concealed thoughts.
changed_reading.after: God knows the breast as a time-bearing source where testing, delay, doubt, and self-deception develop toward consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The balance's alignment of two sides, including its branch image of the day's midpoint, activates the focus chiasm as calibrated redistribution of night and day rather than uncontrolled blending.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies the transfer whose amount can be balanced.
Day supplies the temporal quantity explicitly touched by the midpoint image.
Alignment between two things maps onto the two syntactically matched clauses.
The balance of day at its midpoint links measurement directly to the focus's day term.
The straight scale contributes regulated apportionment rather than random mixture.

structural_cues: 57:6 is a strict object/container chiasm: night into day, then day into night.
57:25 joins the balance to standing in equity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alignment, a day-midpoint branch, and a straight scale; I infer that the chiasm depicts measured allocation of temporal portions. It may instead be rhetorical symmetry with no quantitative force.

changed_reading.before: Night and day blur into one another through generic overlap.
changed_reading.after: Their mutual ingress is a calibrated exchange: proportions move while the paired order remains governed and balanced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surface denotes day, while the activated branch is a river; it remains anchored in the repeated ن ه ر root, ingress construction, and 57:12's actual river occurrence. Render it only as a material analogy for temporal flow, never as a claim that النهار lexically means river here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Night is inserted into repeated ن ه ر containers, whose inventory also carries a cut channel of flowing water.

activation_trace.role: The river branch recasts the repeated day container as an exploratory flowing channel.
Ingress supplies material entering and being carried within that channel.
The context's actual rivers activate the otherwise distant watercourse branch.
Flowing supplies the current that turns static containment into transport.

changed_reading.before: Day is a static interval into which night is added.
changed_reading.after: Day can be pictured as an opened current carrying an inflow of darkness, with temporal portions moving like water through a channel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it moves from astronomy to social belonging; it remains anchored in the focus inventory's explicit insider/outsider branch for و ل ج and in 57:13's wall, door, and inside. Render it as an analogy of hidden affiliation, not as the primary lexical sense of يُولِجُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb can image an outsider admitted into an inner circle, while knowledge of breasts tests inward provenance.

activation_trace.role: The inner-circle branch contributes admission of something not originally of the group.
The breast as source anchors true affiliation in what inwardly generates action.
The enclosing wall supplies a social boundary that eventually becomes visible.
The door supplies controlled admission across that boundary.
The intimate-retinue branch turns physical inside into exploratory inward belonging.

changed_reading.before: The two natural domains merely penetrate one another.
changed_reading.after: Their mutual insertion can also image porous membership: what appears admitted may remain inwardly other, and breast-knowledge distinguishes provenance.

strongest_changes: 57:4 expands reciprocal night/day ingress into a four-direction enter/exit and descend/ascend circulation under knowledge.
57:9 preserves the reciprocal baseline but adds a directed emergence from darkness into light.
57:14 changes the known contents of breasts from static secrets into an unfolding causal sequence.
57:25 activates the mirrored syntax as calibrated redistribution through balance and equity.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's exact chiasm and abrupt breast-knowledge clause allowed context to connect cosmic permeability, hidden causation, moral transition, and measure without forcing them into one final reading; the river and inner-circle branches remained live only as contained analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether darkness-to-light direction should affect the reciprocal astronomical clauses or remain a separate contextual analogy.
Whether recurring time merely reveals inward states or participates in their development.
Whether balance language licenses quantitative apportionment or only reinforces formal symmetry.
